text: G59's reading 2, packet d3_pk_propose_0100 (T3-010 to T3-014, 100 lines), before its rows: (1) CHAT: of the 84 lines on T3-014 (moving planning into a chat), the room setting up, advertising, guarding and repairing a chat, sending members there, arguing which chat to use, relaying its decisions back, and members left out of it (AprilKnights c0089, SwissNeutralityZone c0115, TransFlagPlace c0184, hyperlightdrifter c0047) all join the CHAT candidate; GreenCorner-005, a sign written to recruit, is RETURN; calvinandhobbes-046, a member stopping for fear of breaking the plan, is P04's keeping to the template; falcons-019, a call reaching another group's chat, is P01; de-008, finding the sub's social chat, does not show canvas planning (reject). (2) Elsewhere in the packet: P05's clause holds a variant repaired away and a design kept against change (mechanicalkeyboards c0136, switzerland c0061); P07 holds reining in one's own placers over a neighbour (luciomains c0078); P08 holds deals, envoys and moves with neighbours (paladins c0202, xenoblade_chronicles c0027); P09 holds a battle with another group (peterdraws c0004); P10 holds moving when an attempt is overrun (tampabaylightning c0018); P02 holds a copying charge over a design (taiwan c0042); K04 holds fan lore judging retaliation (stevenuniverse c0411); P16 holds thanks between allies (babymetal c0213); P17 holds sending flag talk to a hub (NovaScotia c0003); RETURN takes a visitor or helper who joins through the work (partyparrot c0076, straya c0349). (3) One room: TheHulk-060 (love of a landmark as the reason to help). Held for their nodes: opticgaming-039 (strangers copying a pattern), corridor-069 (seeking the creators' notice, T3-127), detroitlions-012 (upvotes for an outside comment, T3-051), toolband-046 (infiltrating a rival's chat). G59's reading 3, packet d3_pk_propose_0200 (T3-014 91, T3-015 6, T3-016 3), before its rows: the remaining T3-014 lines join CHAT (setting up, advertising, screening and repairing access, relaying decisions, members withdrawing when the chat excludes them: placeDE c0365, vocaloid c0079, theblackvoid c1579), except monero-033 (a newcomer brought by the logo, RETURN) and prequelmemes-017 (a no-attack rule set without a vote, C01). On T3-015, a moderator's one-thread rule beside members unable to stop unknown placers, and moderators removing posts and choosing the design, are P20 (denmark c0182, pitt c0149); routing to outside chats is CHAT (Russiaclan c0015, finland c0022, scotland c0045); hockey talk beside the megathread is outside the model's scope (hawks-051). On T3-016, explanations of the canvas join EXPLAIN (FinalFantasy c0014, HomestarRunner c0091); naming r/place as the setting with no explanation does not show it (DatBoi-004, reject). EXPLAIN takes explanations on both sides of the close, since no element states either, and D3a-54 noted T3-016's place across the close. Next: d3_rulings/propose-spec-0200.txt

G59's reading 4, packet d3_pk_propose_0300 (T3-016, 100 lines), before its rows: members asking what the canvas is, how to place, what a picture shows, why the sub joined in, whether a pixel registered, and members explaining the rule, the timer, the controls, how big works are made and what happened, before, during and after the close, all join EXPLAIN (e.g. MiamiHurricanes c0017, OnePiece c0165, eve c0261, gratefuldead c0020, kcroyals c0035, ohio c0114); a question left unanswered or an explanation refused is part of the same act (australia c0345, ravens c0042, newzealand c0377). Exceptions: OnePiece-066 and leafs-015 are CHAT; OnePiece-067, Slovakia-058 and metalcore-039 are RETURN; de-039, whose source theme also holds a timelapse and a correction, is held by P12 and P22 for those acts; aceattorney-058 (news that the canvas grew) and parabola-019 (the sub's interest in the site's code licence) are outside the model's scope. Next: d3_rulings/propose-spec-0300.txt

G59's reading 5, packet d3_pk_propose_0400 (T3-016 26, T3-017 74), before its rows: the T3-016 lines join EXPLAIN (singapore c0095, smashbros c0045, zelda c0148), except suomi-059 (a visitor brought by the artwork, RETURN) and suomi-060 (talk of bots and site errors after the close, outside the scope). T3-017 holds the subs' ordinary business going on beside the canvas, with no fourth-order node: games, sport, music, local life, April Fools jokes and tournaments, moderators and bots (e.g. Madeon c0016, australia c0024, chicago c0037, clashroyale c0278); these lines are outside the model's scope, which G59 names, and they become particulars. Exceptions: androidgaming-050 and -051 and armok-041 take people who came from the canvas into the room's own activity (RETURN); ElderScrolls-025 credits another room for a work, P11's credit of makers; bostonbruins-063 makes a call to fix the logo in a game thread's intermission, P01; bitcoin-048, anime_irl-070 and counting-011 are NONPORTABLE. Next: d3_rulings/propose-spec-0400.txt

G59's reading 6, packet d3_pk_propose_0500 (T3-017, 100 lines), before its rows: the subs' ordinary business beside the canvas is outside the model's scope (particular). Exceptions: a call made in a game thread's intermission is P01 (flyers c0191); the canvas result folded into a weekly roundup is P11's announcement (cuboulder c0033), and a karma-theft charge against a reposter with props to the maker is P11's credit (redhotchilipeppers c0088, c0102); people and skills found through the event reused for another task are P13's new purpose (denmark c0355); members offering another activity instead of the badge talk answer the flood, P20 (miamidolphins c0138); a cooperating visitor turned fan and visitors answered in the game's talk join RETURN (minnesotavikings c0304, necrodancer c0069); defence fitted around an exam and a daily check-in join COST (pakistan c0057, russia c0022); a bare correction of the venue's name does not show EXPLAIN (kuwait-043, reject); counting-044 and eder-013 are NONPORTABLE. Next: d3_rulings/propose-spec-0500.txt

G59's reading 7, packet d3_pk_propose_0600 (T3-017 77, T3-018 23), before its rows: the T3-017 lines are the subs' ordinary business, outside the scope, with these exceptions: newcomers who came from the canvas and are welcomed or taken into the room's own activity join RETURN (soylent c0036, wales c0057, worldpowers c0051); pixels put ahead of study joins COST (thenetherlands c0311); a member explaining the five-minute rule joins EXPLAIN (thenetherlands c0313); members reclaiming the sub from 'all that pixel crap' at the close answer the flood, P20 (toolband c0241); a fandom's internal feud paused for the canvas and resumed at its close is one room's (starvstheforcesofevil c0333, particular); tagpro-052 and -054 govern a newcomer's ban, the same one-room need as tagpro-053 (particular); satania-063, unturned-044 and wine-044 are NONPORTABLE. T3-018 (decoding the finished picture's details, in T4-003 with T3-016) has no element; members asking and correcting what a picture shows, whose mark it is and where a design came from join EXPLAIN, whose statement now names the pictures as well as the canvas and its rules (FinalFantasy c0111, ghibli c0035, portugal c0139, shield c0101); arguing which game a figure comes from is the fandom's own talk (metalgearsolid-045 and -046, outside the scope). Next: d3_rulings/propose-spec-0600.txt

G59's reading 8, packet d3_pk_propose_0700 (T3-019 to T3-031, 100 lines), before its rows: (1) Two more candidate groups, each in several rooms and stated by no element: SPOT, the room chooses where to put its work and changes the spot while it builds, before any loss: it looks for open room, weighs a crowded or contested place, shrinks or moves the design ahead of a neighbour or the void, restarts a misplaced start, and refuses to move once enough pixels are in (ManningPlace c0025, albania c0031, httyd c0012, OKState c0018, undertale c0232, WPI c0040); P10 states moving only after the work is erased or overrun, so these lines are not P10's, and Cornwall-029 (held from packet 0000) and teslamotors-038 (ruled P08 in the first spec, now moved here before any build) join SPOT. JOKE, members make new jokes out of the canvas work, puns on the mark and its mistakes, mock titles for a figure, jokes about attackers and bots, and the room takes them up (OnePiece c0325, dmt c0020, monalisaclan c0178, PinkVomitMonster c0024, funhaus c0053); K04 states jokes and lore carried in from before the canvas, which still hold heyyea-027 (He-Man music) and AyyMD-058 (the sub's heretic petitions). farmcarrots-025, a room formed to grow carrots that names itself humble farmers, joins BORN. (2) Held: P14 holds arguing over and adjusting scripts and bots (feedthebeast c0104, dota2 c1167, epublica c0074, zootopia c0122, KState c0022); P06 a chart of helpers and attackers (TheB1G c0035); P05 corrections undone by keepers (dragonquest c0082); P10 effort shifted or restarted after a loss (undertale c0147, torontoraptors c0065); P19 a host refusing space (warthunder c0078); P08 an alliance threatened (COSI c0006); P11 locating the finished mark (haskell c0086); K01 the sub reskinned for April (CKCrusaders c0007). (3) EXPLAIN takes explanations and whether late pixels count (wildhockey c0192, rocketleague c0760, Rainbow6 c0215); RETURN takes lapsed or new members drawn in by the sign (evex c0021, mylittlepony c0058, sheffield c0061) and a redirect left where misled visitors land (ssbpm c0129); CHAT takes chats for relocation updates and scripts (paranatural c0007, rpi c0037); COST takes pixels tied up by members' other commitments and building cut off by going mobile (scp c0094, adventuretime c0008). (4) Outside the scope: the sub's April Fools hunts, swaps and styling (thesilphroad, fireemblem, ssbpm, cfb, giantbomb, leagueoflegends, MMA-048), unrelated jokes and abuse. One room: corridor-016 (an apology between members after yelling over a pixel), bulgaria-028 (every flag called beautiful), zootopia-018 (a bot making upkeep boring and freeing a member). NONPORTABLE: latin-022, calvinandhobbes-045, england-030, Thegreatblackhole-040. Next: d3_rulings/propose-spec-0700.txt
